title: The Icon Battles: Game
description:
Take a break from working on your important documents and blow off some steam!Fight your desktop icons!The Icon Battles: Game allows you to battle your desktop icons, making it a one-of-a-kind game. Play as any desktop icon you have and choose one of the classes:
 • Archer
 
• Axeman
 
• Swordsman
 
• Melee
 
• And more in future updates
ScenariosCustomize your battlefield by selecting which classes are able to participate in battles.Timing-based combatDodge attacks and strike your opponents when they are vulnerable.
description_short: Fight your desktop icons! Play as any of your desktop icons, choose one of different classes, dodge the attacks and strike back!
